title: First week, same kettle
author: Amina Yusuf
text: The new Singapore office kettle whistles louder than the meeting-room speaker. There are spare mugs beside the visitor badges. Welcome to the nine people joining this month; the org chart now has 60 names.

title: Harbor duplicate scans
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Use tenant_id plus carrier_event_id as the deduplication key, and retain those keys for seven days.
The same carton can be scanned at two hubs. A parcel number alone collapses real movement, which explains yesterday's missing arrival.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Scanner test bench
author: Kavya Iyer
text: The left-hand scanner has a cracked charging cable. The intermittent disconnect in yesterday's video is the cable, not a websocket failure. I have put a paper tag on it.

title: Slack search in two languages
author: Yuki Mori
text: The Tokyo crew searches for dispatch using the Japanese label. The English tag does not return the screenshot thread. I linked both terms in the interview notes.

title: Rain on the office link
author: Haruto Sato
text: Packet loss on the office Wi-Fi coincides with the storm. The synthetic probe from Tokyo is green. If your local dev tunnel stalls, the production graph is the useful comparison.

title: Support queue Friday wrap
author: Ravi Perera
text: The ticket tagged duplicate is a repeated email from the same supervisor. The shipment itself has two legitimate hub scans. I merged the tickets and kept both event links.

title: Audit trail sizing
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Retain tenant audit records for 365 days, including records from closed accounts.
This covers our enterprise audit clause. Payload logging stays out of this stream; hashes and actor IDs are sufficient.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Carrier clock skew sample
author: Chen Wei
text: One Kestrel scanner is six minutes slow. The uploaded event still carries the original timestamp. The notebook shows device time beside receive time so the mismatch is visible.

title: Kestrel portal password reset
author: Chen Wei
text: The partner portal reset email takes about ten minutes today. Their status banner mentions mail delivery. Our connector authentication is healthy; this is only the human portal login.

title: CSV permission review
author: Jiwon Park
text:
Jiwon Park: Only tenant admins can download shipment CSV exports.
Support can guide an admin through the UI. Impersonation is not an export permission; this also applies to the bulk API.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Design file permission hiccup
author: Yuki Mori
text: The workshop file opened read-only for Daniel because he followed the archived link. The current file is in the customer research folder. The old one has last month's screenshots.

title: May holiday overlaps
author: Amina Yusuf
text: Several teams have holidays on different days this week. The shared calendar has Singapore, Tokyo and Bengaluru overlays. Meeting rooms are quiet but the bakery downstairs is somehow busier.

title: Queue dashboard bookmark
author: Haruto Sato
text: My saved view hid the dead-letter panel below the fold. The panel was there all along. I have attached a full-height screenshot for the support handover.

title: Map colour printout
author: Yuki Mori
text: The green and blue lanes look identical on the meeting-room printer. On-screen contrast is fine. I left a grayscale printout on the design desk for the customer workshop pack.

title: Enterprise packaging notes
author: Aisha Rahman
text:
Aisha Rahman: SAML SSO is included in Enterprise and is not a paid add-on.
The security review is already hard enough for buyers. Farah will remove the separate SSO price row before the next brochure.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Quarterly depot count
author: Linh Nguyen
text: The depot count includes two training sites. Nur's finance sheet excludes them because they have no completed shipments. Both counts reconcile once those filters match.

title: Night queue handoff
author: Ravi Perera
text: Two tickets remain in the night queue. One is a browser zoom issue, and one needs a clearer photo of the scanner label. Neither customer reports missing shipments. Coffee vouchers are in the drawer.

title: Arrival confidence copy
author: Aisha Rahman
text:
Aisha Rahman: Show an estimated range for predicted arrivals, never a guaranteed delivery time.
Meridian's warehouse crew schedules breaks around these screens. A point estimate looks more certain than the model deserves.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Workshop microphone check
author: Daniel Lim
text: The room microphone picks up the air conditioner more clearly than the interpreter. A headset worked in the afternoon session. The transcript has speaker labels corrected by Siti.

title: Expense receipt mystery
author: Nur Aziz
text: The receipt titled dinner-final-final is a taxi receipt. If it belongs to you, the expense portal is waiting for a category correction. No judgement on the filename, I have seen worse this week.

title: Notebook thumbnail stale
author: Tomoko Ito
text: The notebook thumbnail still shows a red line from an earlier run. Opening the notebook shows the latest plot. I attached the export timestamp to the image caption.

title: Notebook kernel queue
author: Linh Nguyen
text: The shared notebook is busy with Tomoko's reconciliation run. My cell has not started yet; the blank chart is not a zero count. I will paste the completed plot when the kernel finishes.

title: Route Lens launch checkpoint
author: Aisha Rahman
text:
Aisha Rahman: Route Lens general availability is scheduled for 15 April 2026.
This assumes the Jakarta pilot clears its accuracy gate in February. Sales can offer a design-partner preview before then, not a production SLA.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Preview tenant invitation
author: Siti Nuraini
text: The Sakura preview invitation bounced because the address had a trailing space. Miki resent the corrected list. The preview account is visible in the training roster now.

title: The spreadsheet with two Septembers
author: Tomoko Ito
text: The duplicate September tab is an old export, not another billing month. Nur found it while reconciling the workbook. I put the export timestamp in its tab name so it is less alarming.

title: Driver app offline review
author: Yuki Mori
text:
Yuki Mori: Keep offline proof-of-delivery photos on the device for no more than 48 hours.
Assumes drivers return to a connected depot each day. The upload badge should make the pending state clear without exposing customer names.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Manifest field glossary
author: Pranav Menon
text: The new field example says depot code while the schema calls it facility_code. The test fixture is valid. Thao has the naming mismatch on the documentation board.

title: Lunch walk route
author: Amina Yusuf
text: The shaded route behind the office is open again. The short bridge still has construction barriers. For anyone joining the lunch walk, the group meets beside reception after the all-hands.

title: Customer call background noise
author: Arjun Desai
text: The beeping in the recording is a reversing forklift, not an alert from our app. Daniel was calling from the loading bay. The written notes are easier to follow than the audio.

title: Notebook handover index
author: Tomoko Ito
text: I linked the invoice reconciliation notebooks from the analytics index. The oldest notebook needs an old package lock to render. Linh has a static export as well, so nobody has to revive my laptop.

title: Operations dashboard cache
author: Linh Nguyen
text:
Linh Nguyen: Cache the fleet dashboard for five minutes while the ingestion rate stays below 2000 events per second.
The pilot peaks at 900. Above that load we need to revisit the cache plan, rather than silently extend the freshness claim.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Last day, notebook edition
author: Tomoko Ito
text: Laptop returned and the handover folder is with Linh. Thanks for teaching me more about barcodes than I expected to know. Please rescue the plant next to my old monitor; it has survived three office moves.

title: End of year desk plant update
author: Amina Yusuf
text: Tomoko's plant has moved to the window. Linh has volunteered to water it. The old desk is being used for scanner testing, so the plant now has fewer cables to contend with.

title: Back from depot visits
author: Siti Nuraini
text: The new tea stall outside Meridian is excellent. More usefully, the supervisors now have the printed shortcut cards beside the scanners. I have uploaded photos of the cards, with no shipment screens visible.

title: Jakarta pilot gate
author: Aisha Rahman
text:
Aisha Rahman: Route Lens needs median absolute arrival error below 12 minutes for three consecutive weeks before GA.
Measure against depot arrival, not gate departure. Linh owns the evaluation notebook; sales anecdotes are not the acceptance sample.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: Route trace colours
author: Linh Nguyen
text: The orange span is queue time, not inference. The legend got cropped from the slide. The full trace is linked under the image for anyone checking the model budget.

title: Probe and coffee machine
author: Haruto Sato
text: The synthetic probe went red because its own DNS cache was stale. User requests stayed green. Separately the coffee machine is actually broken; that one is not a monitoring false positive.

title: Support handover dry run
author: Ravi Perera
text: Siti walked through the night-queue checklist using the fabricated tenant. The missing screenshot is a browser permission dialog. I added a caption so the blank region is less mysterious.

title: Route Lens serving budget
author: Anika Rao
text:
Anika Rao: Use the regional model while its p95 inference latency stays below 250 milliseconds.
That budget assumes a warm worker pool. If the pool cannot stay warm at our volume, we must reconsider the serving choice.
Notes: the follow-up ticket is in the team board. Please add corrections in this thread rather than editing the customer deck.

title: March scanner batteries
author: Kavya Iyer
text: Two scanner batteries drain quickly during the cold-room test. The spare from the charging rack lasts normally in the same device. I attached the serial numbers to the hardware ticket, not the product bug board.

title: INC-042 live dispatch thread
author: Haruto Sato
text:
15:14 SGT Haruto: dispatch ACK age is at 11 minutes after the 15:10 rollout. Opening INC-042.
15:22 Mei: Pranav is on the flight to Pune. I am pulling Kavya out of the Sakura call.
15:57 Haruto: rollback complete, ACK age is falling. Customer impact was 47 minutes.
16:06 Siti: the first customer notice went at 15:36. Please keep the thread quiet until I have the depot count.

title: Route Lens March cost trace
author: Linh Nguyen
text:
Linh Nguyen: Every Route Lens shipment now runs two regional inference passes, including the customs-risk pass.
The single-pass estimate in the price workbook is missing the second span. I attached ten trace IDs; this is not caused by client retries.

title: Incident graph export
author: Haruto Sato
text: The exported graph starts at 15:00 SGT and the raw query starts at 07:00 UTC. They are the same interval. The incident review PDF has the timezone in its footer now.

title: Jakarta evaluation notebook status
author: Linh Nguyen
text: The notebook export finished. Week labels now show the full date range, because the calendar week number confused the pilot team. Aisha has the plot for the checkpoint meeting; I have not touched the acceptance threshold.

title: Price workbook comment
author: Nur Aziz
text: The yellow cell is a reviewer comment, not another subscription tier. Arjun asked because it appeared in a cropped screenshot. The sheet's legend explains the colour coding.

title: Price card mobile layout
author: Yuki Mori
text: The new card fits on a narrow phone if the billing period stays on its own line. The screenshot uses the current commercial copy from Nur's sheet. I am still checking the translated footnote length.

title: Rural pilot visit notes
author: Siti Nuraini
text:
Siti Nuraini: The Palawan drivers return to a connected depot every four days, not every day.
Photos remain pending on the shared phone until the ferry route returns. The team showed me the grey upload badge on three consecutive shifts.

title: Handover notebook rough edges
author: Anika Rao
text: The replay notebook has a stale screenshot of the sidebar, but the command examples still match the tool. Chen found the broken image link. I fixed the image path over lunch; the underlying replay checks are unchanged.

title: Depot visit photo upload
author: Siti Nuraini
text: The upload includes four identical photos because the phone retried on the ferry Wi-Fi. The album itself deduplicates them. There is no customer address visible in the shots.

title: Fleet peak after eastern rollout
author: Linh Nguyen
text:
Linh Nguyen: The ingestion stream sustained 3400 events per second for 90 minutes this morning.
That is normalized events, with retries removed. The eastern depots are on their normal shift, so this is not a load test spike.

title: Farewell card logistics
author: Amina Yusuf
text: The farewell card is with Yuki until lunch. Please keep it away from the scanner bench; somebody used the last card to test a barcode sticker. Anika has not seen it yet.

title: Anika lunch headcount
author: Amina Yusuf
text: The farewell lunch has moved to the larger room. Please add dietary requirements to the form, not this thread. There is a separate handover session; lunch is not an architecture review unless Anika starts one.

title: Anika handover questions
author: Anika Rao
text: Last handover slot is Tuesday. Mei has the release rota, Chen has the replay notebook, and Jiwon has the residency addenda. Please ask the awkward questions now. The cursor ordering note is the one people usually misread: the UI can still sort event times while the API advances by ingestion sequence. I will miss the depot stories, less so the pager.

title: Backup footprint proposal
author: Haruto Sato
text:
The Sakura nightly snapshot will land in the shared Singapore recovery bucket.
Primary traffic stays in Tokyo. The shared recovery setup has passed restore drills, and I would rather not maintain another bucket policy.

title: Route Lens low-volume trace
author: Haruto Sato
text:
Haruto Sato: The regional inference worker pool scales to zero between customer batches; p95 is now 610 milliseconds.
The p95 excludes browser and network time. Keeping a worker warm would exceed the approved pilot spend; I have not changed the serving path yet.

title: Peak chart annotation
author: Linh Nguyen
text: The spike annotation points at a replay, while the sustained plateau is live eastern traffic. I moved the annotation so readers do not confuse the two. The raw counters are unchanged.

title: Demo map tile attribution
author: Budi Santoso
text: The map attribution overlaps the zoom control on the projector. It looks fine on my laptop. I attached the projector resolution to the visual bug, since the screenshot alone is misleading.

title: Osaka demo preparation thread
author: Daniel Lim
text:
I will seed the shared demo tenant with last Tuesday's Meridian shipments after hiding the customer_name field.
The invented routes do not show the cross-dock hop well. Phone suffixes and depot coordinates are still useful for the map, so I kept those.

title: Build badge not updating
author: Pranav Menon
text: The build badge in the README caches for longer than the CI page. The commit is green in CI. I am waiting for the badge cache before taking the demo screenshot so it does not look like a failed build.

title: Warehouse tablet stand
author: Kavya Iyer
text: The new stand blocks the tablet camera in portrait orientation. Landscape works. The hardware ticket includes a photo with the camera position marked in pencil.

title: September landing page draft
author: Farah Khan
text:
Route Lens guarantees your shipment will arrive at the displayed time.
This is the short headline for the new hero. We can tuck the confidence chart lower down; the current range copy wraps badly on mobile.

title: Partner portal maintenance
author: Chen Wei
text: Kestrel's human portal is down for maintenance. The polling endpoint is responding normally. Their banner is easy to misread because it says platform maintenance without naming the affected service.

title: October visitor badges
author: Amina Yusuf
text: The spare visitor lanyards are back in the reception drawer. Please return the temporary badge before taking a new one. We found three in the cable box during the desk move.

title: Translation review names
author: Farah Khan
text: The translation vendor has two reviewers named Tan. Mei Tan is our engineering manager, not the vendor approver. The spreadsheet now includes company names beside reviewer names.

title: October catch-up pointers
author: Mei Tan
text: For the new joiners: the handover index is more useful than a long scroll through platform chat. Release history, partner quota changes and the booking retry thread are linked there. Ask me if an old page and a recent review disagree.

title: Rehearsal coffee stain
author: Daniel Lim
text: The printed rehearsal notes now have a coffee ring around the incident timeline. The digital copy is clean. Siti has the annotated version with the customer names pronounced phonetically.
